Controls and about the game

How to play

Destroy the other tanks. Choose your angle and power, then fire. Spend your earnings on weapons and defenses between rounds.

For local multiplayer, choose KEYBOARD for each human player. Play with 2–10 tanks and seven types of computer opponent.

Player guide

Keyboard controls

  • ← / →: barrel · ↑ / ↓: power ±1
  • PgUp / PgDn: power ±100
  • Space / Enter: fire · Tab: next weapon
  • I: reverse barrel · H / V: guidance
  • Esc: pause · F10: boss screen

Shop: arrows select an item; Space / + / right-click adds a lot; − / left-click removes it. Enter purchases; D / Esc purchases and leaves.

An independent reconstruction of Tank Wars 3.2 by Kenneth Morse (1992). The original game screen stays in English. Full parity with every DOS behavior has not yet been verified. Fidelity and known differences →
